items.exampleEn: She has always despised dishonest behavior.
items.exampleZh: 她一向鄙視不誠實的行為。

items.exampleEn: The two countries solved the problem peacefully.
items.exampleZh: 那兩個國家和平地解決了問題。

items.exampleEn: The game is psychologically clever: it makes you want to keep playing.
items.exampleZh: 這款遊戲在心理上設計得很巧妙，會讓你一直想玩下去。

items.exampleEn: The course is very demanding, with homework every night.
items.exampleZh: 這門課要求很高，每天晚上都有作業。

items.exampleEn: Much to his irritation, the train was late again.
items.exampleZh: 火車又誤點了，讓他很惱火。

items.exampleEn: Nothing could console him after his dog went missing.
items.exampleZh: 他的狗走失後，什麼都安慰不了他。

items.exampleEn: My parents are tolerant of my loud music.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽能容忍我大聲放音樂。

items.exampleEn: Many students dread the week of final exams.
items.exampleZh: 很多學生都很害怕期末考那一週。

items.sentenceEn: The hero of the story despises unfair rules.
items.sentenceZh: 這個故事的主角痛恨不公平的規定。

items.audioEn: The cat slept peacefully on the sofa while the kids played loudly around it.
items.audioZh: 孩子們在旁邊大聲玩鬧，那隻貓卻在沙發上睡得很安穩。
items.questionZh: 孩子們吵鬧的時候，那隻貓怎麼樣？
options: It played loudly with the kids

items.sentenceEn: I'm dreading cleaning out the garage this weekend, but it has to be done.
items.sentenceZh: 我很怕這個週末要清車庫，但還是得做。

items.sentenceEn: I made tea to console my sister after she failed her driving test.
items.sentenceZh: 妹妹駕照沒考過，我泡了茶安慰她。

items.stemEn: Looking after a newborn baby is ____; parents hardly get any sleep.
items.stemZh: 照顧新生兒很累人，爸媽幾乎沒得睡。

items.stemEn: The coach prepares his players both physically and ____ for big games.
items.stemZh: 教練在大賽前讓球員在身體和心理上都做好準備。

items.passageEn: My first summer job was at a busy bakery. The owner was demanding: every cake had to be perfect, and she noticed every small mistake. At first, I dreaded going to work, and the long hours were psychologically tiring. One day I dropped a whole tray of bread, and I could see the irritation on her face. Later, though, she consoled me and said that she had dropped many trays when she was young. After that, I realized she was more tolerant than she seemed. By the end of the summer, I could work peacefully even when the shop was full. I learned that it is unwise to judge people too quickly.
items.passageZh: 我的第一份暑期工作是在一家很忙的麵包店。老闆要求很高：每個蛋糕都要完美，任何小錯她都看得出來。一開始，我很怕去上班，長時間的工作也讓我心理上很疲憊。有一天，我打翻了一整盤麵包，看得出她臉上的不耐煩。不過後來她安慰我，說她年輕時也打翻過很多盤。從那之後，我發現她比看起來寬容。暑假結束時，即使店裡客滿，我也能平靜地工作。我學到，太快評斷別人是不明智的。

questions.questionZh: 作者打翻麵包後，老闆後來怎麼做？
options: 要作者賠錢，並且再也不准碰烤盤
安慰作者，說她年輕時也常打翻

questions.questionZh: 暑假結束時，作者有什麼改變？
options: 學會自己做各式各樣的蛋糕和麵包
決定以後要開一家自己的麵包店
店裡客滿時也能平靜地工作

items.promptZh: 我們應該對不同的意見更寬容。
referenceEn: We should be more tolerant of different opinions.
We need to be more tolerant of other people's opinions.
rubricZh: tolerant 的用法，例如 tolerant of 等
時態合理（例如 should be、need to be 等）

items.promptZh: 我最痛恨別人在我背後說我壞話。
referenceEn: I despise it when people talk about me behind my back.
I really despise people saying bad things about me behind my back.
rubricZh: despise 表示「非常厭惡」，後面可接名詞、it when 子句或動名詞（例如 despise it when… 等）
「在我背後說我壞話」可寫，例如 talk about me behind my back、say bad things about me 等
寫 What I despise most is… 也正確
